references.text: Dan is mentioned as a tribe with a specific territory, which shows the tribe's geographical location in Israel
Describes Dan's tribal inheritance and their settlement by the coast, explaining the reference to ships and harbors
Gilead on the east side of the Jordan was given to the tribes of Reuben and Gad, which explains why Gilead 'was on the other side of the Jordan'
Describes Asher's inheritance along the coast by the Mediterranean Sea, explaining the reference that Asher 'sat by the seashore'
Jacob's blessing over Zebulun mentions that he shall dwell at the seashore and be a haven for ships, using similar language as in the verse
Jacob's prophecy about Dan as a tribe, relevant to understanding Dan's role and character
Moses' blessing over Dan describes the tribe as a lion's cub, relevant to understanding the tribe's character
